Shell(node -e  import fs from 'fs'; // Extract all wugweb.online URLs from case studies data and map to local paths const cs = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('notion-data/case-studies.json','utf8')); const assetSheet = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('notion-data/asset-sheet.json','utf8')); // Build map of all URLs from case study data with path info const urls = []; for(const c of cs) { for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(c)) { if(typeof v === 'string' && v.startsWith('https://wugweb.online')) { // Extract filename from URL const urlObj = new URL(v); const pathParts = urlObj.pathname.split('/').filter(Boolean); // pathname looks like: assets/work/ClientName/filename.mp4 // Remove 'assets' prefix → work/ClientName/filename.mp4 let localPath = pathParts.slice(1).join('/'); // Handle uppercase folder names — Notion sheet uses lowercase const fileName = pathParts.pop(); const folder = pathParts.slice(1).join('/').toLowerCase(); // Try to find in asset sheet const assetMatch = assetSheet.find(a => a['File Name'] && fileName && a['File Name'].toLowerCase() === fileName.toLowerCase() ); if(assetMatch && assetMatch['Relative Path'] && assetMatch['Relative Path'] !== '—') { localPath = assetMatch['Relative Path']; } else { localPath = folder + '/' + fileName; } urls.push({ url: v, path: localPath, key: k }); } } } // Deduplicate const seen = new Set(); const unique = urls.filter(u => { const key = u.path + u.url; if(seen.has(key)) return false; seen.add(key); return true; }); fs.writeFileSync('notion-data/asset-urls.json', JSON.stringify(unique, null, 2)); console.log('Extracted', unique.length, 'unique wugweb.online asset URLs'); console.log('Paths include:', [...new Set(unique.map(u => u.path.split('/')[0]))].join(', '));  2 >& 1)
